<thought>We have the list of valid functional groups. To find a template for a nucleophilic aromatic substitution (SNAr) where an aryl halide is replaced by a primary amine, we will search the template catalog for reactions that break an "aryl halide" functional group and form a "primary amines" functional group. The target product is a nitro‑substituted aniline, represented by SMILES "c1ccc(cc1[N+](=O)[O-])N". We'll request up to 5 matching templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1[N+](=O)[O-])N",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
